name: Kimpton Blythswood Square Hotel
positioning: Georgian townhouse hotel with a spa on Blythswood Square in Glasgow (officially Kimpton Blythswood Square Hotel & Spa)
best_for: Travelers who want a spa stay within walking distance of Glasgow's central station and Buchanan Street

facts.text: The hotel is housed in what was once The Royal Scottish Automobile Club.
The hotel is a five-minute walk from Glasgow central station and Buchanan Street shops.
The Penthouse Suite has a private rooftop garden.
The Penthouse Suite has a sunken bath and a steam room.
Spa treatments are inspired by the Scottish Hebrides.
Hotel residents have exclusive access to the spa twice a day.
Pets are welcome at no additional charge.
Valet and self-parking are available via Q Park Sauchiehall St.

highlights.text: The spa has a snow room, multiple saunas, a steam room and a hot tub.
The downstairs restaurant has a green tile-clad bar.
The hotel has a private cinema and offers rooftop cocktail receptions for events.

considerations.text: The hotel has no complimentary local area shuttle.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Kimpton Blythswood Square Hotel
